test_inference_dropout_retained: test that retain_dropout sets apply_during_inference to true on encoder and decoder dropout modules
test_inference_dropout_default_false: test that dropout modules default to not applying during inference when retain_dropout is unset
test_training_mode_toggle: test that calling eval on the transformer model disables training mode on all dropout modules
test_selective_retain_modules: test that retain_dropout_modules selectively retains dropout only on specified module types like TransformerEncoder
test_transformer_model_build: test building a TransformerModel with custom encoder and decoder layer counts using build_model
